svg.metadata: {"changes": "Isolate original race-route geometry; omit annotations, pit lanes, alternative routes, sectors, flags, backgrounds and white halo. Black paint, rounded stroke and proportional padded SVG viewport; original path data and transforms are unchanged.", "credit": "Will Pittenger; metadata cleanup by Cherkash", "historicalApplicability": "Select path4777, the only 15-unit black-stroked race-loop use in the source, not gray path4003 (regular GP infield). Official F1 announcement explicitly assigns the 11-turn 3.543 km Outer Track to 2020 round16 Sakhir, contrasting round15 regular 5.412 km Bahrain GP.", "license": "CC-BY-SA-3.0", "licenseUrl": "https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/", "page": "https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bahrain_International_Circuit--Outer_Circuit.svg", "sourceSha256": "4c7e08bafdb93b408559a79ce44fe1f650e97c6d0e317b0a20cddbe88511904a", "url": "https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/61/Bahrain_International_Circuit--Outer_Circuit.svg"}
svg.desc: Authentic source transforms applied; proportionally sampled route with subpixel curve tolerance; uniform black double contour with transparent center and background; no labels.
